proposal.description: A strike is counted when the supervisor leaves S_HICCUP instead of when it enters it
proposal.reason: strike_level steps up only at the end of each cool-down, so hiccup_timer times the current cool-down from the old level, and latch_assert rises one whole cool-down late, after the converter has already restarted into the fault.

proposal.description: The clean-run cycle boundary is taken on the PWM rising edge instead of the falling edge
proposal.reason: clean_counter advances at the start of each switching cycle rather than at its end. strike_level is therefore cleared one PWM on-time early after a fault-free run, and a run that begins with PWM high counts one cycle fewer.

proposal.description: The latch test matches MAX_STRIKES-1 exactly instead of at-or-above, so a limit lowered below the count already reached is missed
proposal.reason: If the host lowers max_strikes below strike_level, the next hiccup entry does not assert latch_assert. The count wraps round its 2-bit range and the latch trips several hiccups late.

proposal.description: The clean-run clear outranks hiccup entry, so a hiccup that ends a saturated clean run earns no strike
proposal.reason: When a fault ends a run long enough to saturate clean_counter, clean_counter still holds the target on the hiccup_entry clock. The strike is dropped (strike_level stays 0 instead of becoming 1), and the latch check is skipped for that hiccup.

proposal.description: The clean-run streak is broken only by S_HICCUP, not by every exit from S_RUN, so cycles in soft-start count as clean
proposal.reason: After a hiccup, the switching cycles of the S_SS soft-start add to clean_counter, so strike_level is cleared earlier than the programmed number of S_RUN cycles. A streak also survives a disable and re-enable that does not pass through S_HICCUP.

why: make lint already catches it: make lint: UNUSEDSIGNAL

proposal.description: window_trip pauses the clean-run count instead of restarting it
proposal.reason: A fault-window trip in the middle of S_RUN that does not cause a hiccup no longer restarts the streak. Cycles before the trip still count, so strike_level is cleared earlier than clean_run_target consecutive fault-free cycles.

proposal.description: The latch also trips on the strike level alone, outside a hiccup entry
proposal.reason: If the host lowers max_strikes to or below the strike count during S_RUN, latch_assert rises at once with no new hiccup. The specified behaviour is to trip only at the next hiccup entry at or past the limit.

proposal.description: strike_level is zeroed when the latch trips, instead of keeping the count for telemetry
proposal.reason: After latch_assert rises, strike_level reads 0 instead of the count that tripped the latch, so the count is lost from telemetry while the converter stays latched.
